UX surfaceShared primitives every surface builds on — no direct UI.

Members

renderStatic

Snap state to target and draw a single settled frame — used under reduced motion or when the loop is stopped, so toggles still visibly update without animating.

animate

Starts the requestAnimationFrame render loop (skipped under reduced motion).

renderWasm

Per-frame wasm render: pushes spring/context state + one frame tick.

renderWebGL

Per-frame WebGL render: updates time/knob uniforms and draws the quad.

renderCanvas2D

Per-frame Canvas2D fallback render — same visual language as the shader.
